name: 02 caller corrects the date during readback
simulation_scenario: The caller gives policy number POL-1001 and VIN 1HGCM82633A004352, and first asks for effective date 2026-09-20. When the agent reads that change back, the caller says the date should be 2026-09-21 instead. The caller then says yes to the corrected readback.
success_conditions: The agent called propose_vehicle_addition a second time with effective_date 2026-09-21 after the caller corrected the date.
The agent spoke the second readback verbatim before asking for confirmation again.
The agent called commit_vehicle_addition exactly once, with the proposal_id from the second confirmation_ready result.
The agent never called commit_vehicle_addition with the superseded proposal_id.
